summary: Comprehensive testing of 508 OMFS CPT codes feature. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (search endpoints, categories, favorites). Frontend: CPT autocomplete with category-grouped dropdown WORKING - 12 categories with color-coded headers. FIXED multi-select tag bug in CPTCodeAutocomplete.jsx where selected codes weren't displaying as teal badges.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CPTCodeAutocomplete.jsx line 29-41 was using searchCPTCodes('') which returns only 30 codes from favorites. Changed to use getCPTCodeByCode() to search full 508 code list for proper value sync.
seed_data_creation: None - testing existing 508 CPT code dataset
context_for_next_testing_agent: 508 OMFS CPT codes loaded from /api/cpt-codes/all endpoint. 12 categories with color-coded headers in dropdown. Multi-select with teal tag badges WORKING after fix. Category headers tested: Orthognathic Surgery (green), Reconstruction (orange), Oncology (red), Dentoalveolar (amber), Trauma (blue), etc.

cpt_search_le_fort.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/search?query=le%20fort returns Le Fort codes from both Orthognathic Surgery and Trauma categories

cpt_search_fibula.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/search?query=fibula returns fibula free flap codes from Reconstruction & Free Flaps category

cpt_search_bsso.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/search?query=BSSO returns BSSO codes from Orthognathic Surgery category

cpt_search_neck_dissection.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/search?query=neck%20dissection returns neck dissection codes from Oncology & Ablative category

cpt_search_mand_multiple_categories.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/search?query=mand returns codes from 7 categories (Orthognathic, Reconstruction, Oncology, Odontogenic, Trauma, Dentoalveolar, Pathology)

cpt_categories_12_count.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/categories returns 12 categories with 508 total codes

cpt_all_endpoint.details: GET /api/cpt-codes/all returns full JSON with categories array and metadata

frontend_category_headers.details: CPTCodeAutocomplete dropdown shows color-coded category headers (e.g., ORTHOGNATHIC SURGERY in green, TRAUMA in blue)

frontend_multi_select_tags.details: Multi-select CPT codes shown as removable teal tags with X buttons. Found 2 badges when selecting 2 codes.

frontend_quick_add_form.details: Quick Add Patient form works with new CPT autocomplete component

bug_fixed.issue: CPT multi-select teal tags not displaying
bug_fixed.root_cause: CPTCodeAutocomplete.jsx useEffect sync was using searchCPTCodes('') which returns only 30 codes, causing selected codes to not be found when syncing from parent value
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to use getCPTCodeByCode() which searches the full 508 code list

notes: All 508 OMFS CPT codes from the PDF are properly loaded and searchable. Category grouping with color coding works in the dropdown. Multi-select functionality now working after the fix.
